candidates.hook: Lady Ashcroft coldly demands Juliana hand over her late mother's ledger: 'Enough sentiment. And the ledger... that belongs to this family.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's new husband confronts Gerald's insults with a low, deadly threat: 'Choose your next words carefully.'
candidates.why: Combines intense stepmother cruelty (flinging an heirloom in the dirt) with a swoon-worthy rescue and intense confrontation cliffhanger.

candidates.hook: Lord Ashcroft disowns Juliana on the cathedral steps: 'You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches Juliana's mother's heirloom book away and flings it into the wet courtyard mud as Juliana screams.
candidates.why: Delivers a double emotional punch of public disinheritance followed immediately by severe physical humiliation.

moments.desc: Lord Ashcroft formally disowns Juliana, revoking her dowry, inheritance, and family name.
Lady Ashcroft snatches Juliana's late mother's ledger and flings it disdainfully into the wet mud.
Gerald mocks Juliana as a beggar's wife, prompting her rugged new husband to issue a lethal threat.
